payload.summary: Volunteer-focused administration, clearer installer progress, and shared-host efficiency improvements.
release_notes: Added a volunteer-oriented administration dashboard and task-focused navigation.
Added a five-step Add Walk wizard using the existing Walk permissions and save process.
Added dismissible first-run guidance for administrators.
Improved healthy automatic installer progress states while preserving resumable recovery.
Applied stored homepage hero focal points and corrected the packaged default crop.
Added bounded request diagnostics and OPcache visibility for shared-host troubleshooting.
Reduced repeated shared-host application work using request-scoped and shared-host-safe caching.
